# netbox_service_template (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get service template by name
data "netbox_service_template" "test" {
  name = "test"
}

// Get service template by id
data "netbox_service_template" "test_by_id" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `ports` (Set of Number)
- `protocol` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String)
